note: Golden embeddings produced by Python sentence-transformers as ground truth for the Rust ONNX pipeline. Rust ONNX inference (fp32) must match with cosine >= 0.9999; quantized ONNX uses a >= 0.99 acceptance gate (see context doc §2.2).
